scripts.nakama:up: sh -c 'if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml up -d --wait; else docker-compose -f infra/compose.yaml up -d --wait; fi'
scripts.nakama:down: sh -c 'if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml down; else docker-compose -f infra/compose.yaml down; fi'
scripts.test:nakama: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('artifacts/nakama-integration.json', { force: true })" && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/nakama.integration.ts test/lobby.nakama.ts
scripts.validate:nakama: npm run nakama:up && npm run test:nakama
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm test && npm run evaluate
scripts.marketing:deploy: npm run marketing:build && npx wrangler@3.114.17 pages deploy dist/marketing --project-name lokiplay
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:build && npx wrangler@3.114.17 pages deploy dist/docs --project-name lokiplay-docs
